title: PHP & MVC Fundamentals
description: Routes, controllers, models, views, and stable application state.

questions.prompt: Which MVC component is primarily responsible for retrieving and organizing application data?
questions.explanation: Models handle data access and business data. Views focus on presentation.

questions.prompt: Which component receives this request after the route matches?
questions.explanation: The route maps the URL to QuizController::show.

questions.prompt: A View should query the database directly whenever it needs fresh data.
questions.explanation: The Controller and Model prepare the data. The View renders it.

questions.prompt: What CodeIgniter concept maps an incoming URL to a controller method?
questions.explanation: Routing maps URL patterns to controller methods.

questions.prompt: What should identify a choice internally so shuffling cannot change which answer is correct?
questions.explanation: A stable ID keeps correctness independent from display order.

questions.prompt: Which sequence best represents a typical MVC request flow?
questions.explanation: The route selects a Controller, which uses Models and returns a View.
